page.overview:
Who is Draigo Roget?

Imperial Overseer of Spice Operations|loyalty=Venport Holdings (Josef Venport) House Corrino (Roderick Corrino)|education=Order of Mentats|eyes=dark|hair=long, jet-black}}

Draigo Roget was a student of the early mentat school, which was established by Gilbertus Albans on the planet Lampadas after the Battle of Corrin. Gilbertus considered Draigo to be his finest student, not knowing that he had been recruited by Josef Venport to learn the ways of the mentat for the purposes of advancing Venport Holdings.

Draigo Roget is a student of the original Mentat School, also served as a teaching assistant. He paid for his considerable tuition with a gift from an unnamed benefactor (actually Josef Venport), and nearly finished with everything the Mentat School could teach him in just five years. He was arguably the best student the school had ever had. Gilbertus had never met anyone quite so brilliant.

When Draigo was about to graduate with the highest honors in the history of the school, Gilbertus asked him to consider remaining on Lampadas as an instructor, but Draigo was noncommittal. At that time, Draigo was able to won nearly forty percent of the engagements in war-game against Gilbertus.
